annotator_notes: QSC-vendor 'Annotated CRF' schedule format, 112 pages. Every page prints header chrome (Study/Site, Group/Visit, Slot, Schedule Category & Name) with the schedule name, e.g. 'QSC302573, 03 - Screening Draft v0.1' = form name (study prefix optional). Fields are activity blocks: 'Activity: Name #1' header, line number, then the QUESTION text, 'Staff Initials:', 'Answer(s):', option/answer slots, 'Comment:'. Truth field = question text (user-endorsed convention). Answer slots inside a block (e.g. named measurements/checklist rows) are recorded as acceptable_extras: not required, not punished. Activity headers, option values, date/time templates, SAS bracket annotations are none of them fields.
